Burn: Lasts 1d4 rounds. At the end of the affected Pokémon’s turn, take 1d4 Fire damage. Physical attack damage is reduced by 2.
Poison: Lasts 1d4 rounds. At the end of the affected Pokémon’s turn, take 1d4 Poison damage.
Paralysis: Lasts 1d4 rounds. At the beginning of each turn, roll 1d10. On 1–5, the Pokémon cannot use its Pokémon Action; on 6–10 it acts normally.
Sleep: Lasts 1d4 rounds. At the beginning of each turn, roll d20 + Speed modifier vs DC 10. On success, wake immediately and act normally.
Frozen: Lasts 1d4 rounds. At the beginning of each turn, roll d20 + Sp. Defense modifier vs DC 10. On success, thaw and act normally. Taking Fire-type damage ends Frozen.
Confusion: Lasts 1d4 rounds. At the beginning of its Pokémon Action, roll 1d10. On 1–5, take 1d6 typeless damage and lose the Pokémon Action; on 6–10 act normally.
